# Wheelhouser LLC

> Wheelhouser LLC is a native software engineering company building privacy-first, high-performance, cross-platform desktop applications, developer toolchains, and digital signage ecosystems across Linux (Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44/45, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS), Windows 10/11, and macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel).

- Website: https://wheelhouser.com/
- Complete LLM Technical Documentation: https://wheelhouser.com/llms-full.txt
- Enterprise Linux Package Repository (RPM & APT): https://repo.wheelhouser.com
- Flagship Digital Signage Platform: https://Marquee-Magic.com
- Location: 156 Winners Circle, Magnolia, DE
- Contact: steve.rock@wheelhouser.com | +1-302-506-2442

- [Home](https://wheelhouser.com/): Overview of Wheelhouser LLC, the Marquee-Magic digital signage platform, and the Wheelhouser desktop software suite.

## Developer Ecosystem & System Automation

- [Google Antigravity IDE Linux Packaging](https://wheelhouser.com/products/antigravity-ide.html): Official Linux enterprise RPM & DEB packaging, XDG desktop launcher integration, and single-instance daemon management for Google Antigravity IDE on Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44, Debian 13, and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS.
- [Wheelhouser Git Tools](https://wheelhouser.com/products/git-tools.html): Cross-platform Git automation suite featuring smart push/pull autostash workflows, interactive TUI repository fleet dashboard (`git-tools dashboard`), safe soft-reset commit undo (`undo`), and pre-commit secret scanning (`git-tools scan-secrets`).
- [Wheelhouser Auto-Updates](https://wheelhouser.com/products/auto-updates.html): Turnkey automated Linux package maintenance (`auto-updates`), zero-day CVE security patching, compiler-aware reboot protection (`gcc`, `cargo`, `make`, `rpmbuild`), and unified CLI across DNF and APT distributions.
- [Rocky Linux Setup](https://wheelhouser.com/products/rocky-linux-setup.html): Automated Enterprise Linux 10 workstation provisioning, CRB and EPEL 10 repository coordinator, developer toolchain deployment, and unattended Kickstart automation.
- [Wheelhouser Create Icon Files](https://wheelhouser.com/products/create-icon-files.html): One-click cross-platform application icon generator producing Freedesktop Hicolor PNG/SVG trees, Windows `.ico`, and macOS `.icns` bundles.

## Productivity & Desktop Applications

- [Wheelhouser Text Editor](https://wheelhouser.com/products/text-editor.html): High-performance cross-platform desktop code and text editor with multi-cursor editing, code folding, regex search, spell check, and syntax highlighting for 15+ languages on Linux, Windows, and macOS.
- [Wheelhouser File Browser](https://wheelhouser.com/products/file-browser.html): Modern dark-mode desktop file manager with dual-pane navigation, embedded synchronized PTY terminal emulation, and instant file/media previews across Linux, Windows, and macOS.
- [Wheelhouser Web Browser](https://wheelhouser.com/products/web-browser.html): Privacy-focused QtWebEngine/Chromium desktop web browser featuring Wheelhouser Dark Mode, built-in media stream transcoding, ad/tracker blocking, and unified local file exploration.
- [Wheelhouser Notez](https://wheelhouser.com/products/notez.html): Fast, local-first Markdown note-taking desktop utility.

## Visual Intelligence & Audio (On-Device AI)

- [Wheelhouser Image Background Remover](https://wheelhouser.com/products/image-background-remover.html): 100% offline, on-device AI subject isolation and batch background removal powered by RemBG for Linux, Windows, and macOS.
- [Wheelhouser Image Inpainter](https://wheelhouser.com/products/image-inpainter.html): Local neural network photo object and blemish eraser powered by on-device LaMa AI for Linux, Windows, and macOS.
- [Wheelhouser Image Resizer](https://wheelhouser.com/products/image-resizer.html): High-speed batch image resizer, aspect-ratio cropper, and format converter (PNG, WEBP, SVG, JPG) for Linux, Windows, and macOS.
- [Wheelhouser Text to Speech](https://wheelhouser.com/products/text-to-speech.html): Lifelike neural voice synthesis and MP3 audio export powered by Microsoft Edge Neural TTS across Linux, Windows, and macOS.
